The framework would mandate implementation of progressively stronger security measures based on the nature, variety and scale of digital product offerings of banks.
REQUIREMENTS_DESCRIPTION: Implement appropriate (e.g. centralised) systems and controls to allow, manage, log and monitor privileged/super user/administrative access to critical systems (servers/databases, applications, network devices etc.)
STATUSEXTENDED: There are no log metric filters or alerts associated in project iconic-being-431804-c2.
